_note: Protocol = the paper's R code 1:1 (see the YAML header): measured 2026-08-26 on the refactor/lean-fit branch. Paper Sec. 6.2 in the flow's sign convention (the paper adds the ordinal shift, the flow subtracts it): expected -0.2 and +0.3. The App. C.4 check is convention-free, theory exp(2) = 7.39. The cf_* entries score ordinal counterfactuals against the analytic counterfactual law (paper App. B): an observed level pins the latent to an interval, so only a distribution is identified, cf_prob_true_level_analytic is what predicting that law scores (E[sum p_i^2]) and cf_prob_true_level_mode_bound is the most any prediction can score (always naming the modal level) -- both are expectations while the metric is one finite draw, so neither is a per-run ceiling and a flow above the analytic reference is sharper than the identifiable law rather than better than it. cf_pmf_tv_vs_analytic is the metric that cannot be gamed that way. odds_ratio_predicted is exp(beta12), which this file already pins, so it cannot fail on its own -- it is here because it is the paper's convention-free number, not as a second check.
